title: CodaLauncher 0.8.2: Frontier from the first frame
text: With Frontier selected, the launcher now opens straight into the camp look instead of flashing the blue Classic screen first. Nightly launchers update themselves.

title: H.O.W.L. Frontier 0.4.3: houses in the ground
text: Settlers now dig their houses into the ground on a real foundation, miners keep digging on their own, and a bed that cannot be claimed tells you why. New settings in the Frontier profile set how fast settlers place and break blocks.

title: Coda Companion comes with H.O.W.L.
text: H.O.W.L. 0.0.46 bundles Coda's wolf companion with her icy-white fur in both Stable and Nightly. No separate download needed.

title: Frontier play mode
text: Pick Frontier on Home in CodaLauncher (Windows, Nightly) to play a settlement world with its own worlds, mods and settings, and a pixel-art camp look. Classic stays exactly as it was.

title: Welcome to Coda's workshop
text: H.O.W.L. is our home for community-made Minecraft mods. Stable keeps things familiar; Nightly is where new experiments take their first steps.

title: CodaLauncher is now available for Windows, Linux and macOS
text: Download the launcher and play on Windows (x64), Linux (x64/ARM64) or macOS (Intel/Apple Silicon). The Mac build is not Apple-notarized yet, so approve it once in System Settings, Privacy & Security, on first run.

title: HW Essentials adds saved homes and /back, installed automatically
text: Set homes with /sethome, list them with /homes, teleport with /home, and use /back to return to your last location. Ten home slots by default (configurable 1 to 100). Homes are saved per world and persist across sessions. Click Play in CodaLauncher, and the mod installs itself.

title: A quieter underground
text: New Nightly worlds can use Quiet Underground to make enormous caves and ravines less common. Existing worlds stay as they are.

title: Packs and menu scenes
text: CodaLauncher now includes Packs and Resourcepacks (CML Base and CML Base Resources required). CodaLoader adds classic and experimental Banner Sweep menu scenes that rotate randomly on each title screen visit.

title: CodaLauncher begins
text: A dedicated Howling Whispers launcher is taking shape: news, updates, mods, profiles, settings and logs in one Coda-flavored home.
